jobs.title: Brand and AI Creative Designer
jobs.description:
Ready to shape the future of travel marketing through creativity and innovation? Join TUI Musement as our Brand & AI Creative Designer, where you'll combine outstanding design craft with emerging AI technologies to create impactful brand campaigns, scalable creative systems and engaging customer experiences across global markets.

The role will be published until 5th of November.

About Our Offer

Personal benefits:
Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.

Flexible working:
Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.

A career to shape:
Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.

Broaden your network:
We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams

Community:
Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

You'll develop creative concepts and visual directions for integrated brand campaigns, translating audience insights, campaign objectives and brand strategy into compelling ideas and channel-ready creative solutions.
Creating and adapting assets across digital, social media, CRM, websites, retail environments, print and other customer touchpoints will be a key part of your role.
You'll help shape and evolve brand guidelines, creative frameworks and visual standards, making it easier for teams and markets to deliver consistent and effective brand experiences.
Using AI-assisted creative tools, you'll support ideation, visual exploration, prototyping and asset adaptation while applying strong creative judgement to ensure all outputs remain distinctive and brand-aligned.
You'll build scalable creative systems, templates and toolkits that enable efficient adaptation across markets, languages, formats and channels without compromising creative quality.
Working closely with content, campaign, video, production, commercial and product teams, you'll ensure creative ideas remain consistent and effective throughout delivery.
You'll present creative thinking with confidence, clearly articulating the rationale behind concepts, frameworks and design decisions to a variety of stakeholders.
By identifying opportunities to improve creative processes, brand application and AI-enabled workflows, you'll help make our creative output more consistent, scalable and future-ready.

About You

You have proven experience in brand design, graphic design, campaign creation, art direction or creative development within either an agency or in-house environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English allow you to communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
Your portfolio demonstrates strong concept development and execution across multiple channels, formats and customer touchpoints.
You've successfully contributed to brand guidelines, design systems, campaign toolkits or similar creative frameworks that support consistency and scalability.
Strong design craft enables you to create high-quality work across layout, typography, visual hierarchy, imagery and art direction for both digital and print channels.
You're confident using Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent professional design tools to bring ideas to life from concept through to final delivery.
Experience with AI-assisted creative tools, generative workflows or creative automation is highly desirable, alongside the ability to evaluate and refine outputs with a critical eye.
You can translate strategic objectives into compelling visual concepts and communicate your ideas through engaging storytelling and presentations.
Organised, proactive and collaborative, you're comfortable managing multiple briefs, stakeholder groups, feedback rounds and deadlines while maintaining creative excellence.
Experience working across multilingual, multi-market or matrix organisations would be advantageous.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Subko
is seeking a concept-forward Brand Strategist + Storyteller
to build and safeguard our brand presence in the UAE (Al Serkal Avenue, Dubai). This role bridges big-picture conceptual thinking with high-craft written narrative and agile content execution.

This role requires you to be a strategic architecture (Brand Strategy, Content Ecosystem, and Partnerships Strategy) and also own narrative execution (Tone of Voice, Copywriting, Campaign Storytelling, and Agile Content Creation).

While offline community events and physical venue management are handled by separate operational/community teams, you are the master narrator
, turning product drops, design choices, craft provenance, and brand partnerships into captivating, world-class content across all digital and brand touchpoints.

Core Responsibilities

Pillar 1: Brand, Content & Partnerships Strategy (65% Focus)

Brand Strategy & Localization: Adapt Subko’s core positioning for the UAE market—translating South Asian craft and origin stories for Dubai’s design-forward, specialty coffee, and cultural audience without over-explaining or diluting the brand identity.
Content Strategy Architecture: Define and maintain Subko UAE’s multi-platform content strategy (Instagram, TikTok, emerging channels). Build structured content pillars around Product, Craft & Provenance, Culture, and Behind-the-Scenes.
Strategic Partnerships: Identify and shape high-impact brand partnerships, co-branding initiatives, and cultural collaborations in Dubai (design, lifestyle, art, and hospitality entities).
Cross-Market Alignment: Collaborate closely with Subko India’s Brand and Design HQ to ensure global narrative consistency while tailoring GCC-specific content strategies.

Pillar 2: Content Storytelling, Tone of Voice & Execution (35% Focus)

Master Tone of Voice & Copywriting: Own all outward-facing written copy across campaigns, product launches, social channels, and in-store collateral; executing high-standard written copy in alignment with Subko’s brand voice and writing guidelines.
Product Drop & Narrative Arcs: Turn every launch into a multi-phase narrative journey (Pre-launch tease Launch moment post-launch depth), tying coffee origins, bakery items, and design drops back into Subko’s broader universe.
Creative Direction & Production: Lead visual and narrative direction for shoots. Write creative briefs for photographers and videographers and build aesthetic reference boards for Subko storytelling.
Agile Content Creation: Independently capture and edit quick-turnaround, high-craft digital content for time-sensitive moments using mobile creative tools (CapCut, Lightroom, Canva, Premiere, or equivalent).
Translating Venue to Screen: Capture authentic & raw moments from Subko's lens and convert them into compelling online stories (without managing the physical offline events/community ops yourself).

Key Requirements

Experience: 10-12 years in brand strategy, content strategy, creative direction, editorial writing, or brand communications within specialty coffee, F&B, design, luxury, or culture-led brands.
Narrative Mastery: Exceptional written English skills with a demonstrated ability to write nuanced, engaging brand copy and build cohesive storytelling campaigns.
Strategic & Visual Eye: Proven track record of developing multi-channel content ecosystems and directing visual creative teams (photo/video).
UAE Market Nuance: Deep familiarity with Dubai’s culture, design, and F&B landscape.
Hands-on Execution: Proficient in quick-turnaround content capture/editing (CapCut, Lightroom, Canva, or similar platforms) for rapid digital publishing along with management systems like Notion & Google workspace for process flow management.

Kayana is seeking a creative, commercially driven, and results-oriented Content & Social Media Lead
to transform our digital presence through a video-first, organic-first content strategy that strengthens brand awareness, drives audience engagement, and generates business opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a natural storyteller, confident on-camera presenter, and hands-on content creator

Working closely with the wider Marketing, Sales, and Creative teams, the position will ensure that Kayana's digital content supports our commercial objectives and international market expansion.

Develop and execute a video-first, organic-first content strategy aligned with Kayana's brand positioning and commercial objectives.

jobs.description:
instashop, headquartered in Dubai, is the leading online local marketplace in the UAE and Egypt . Since joining the Delivery Hero family in 2020, the global leader in online food delivery and q-commerce, instashop has been setting the standard for excellence and convenience in the region.

With a dynamic and motivated team fueled by passion and innovation, every day at instashop is an opportunity for growth and success. We champion inclusivity, diversity and collaboration, creating an environment where everyone’s achievements are celebrated and where success is the only way forward. As we continue to grow, our team keeps expanding across the UAE, Egypt and Greece, and we’re always on the lookout for new talents to join us on our success journey.

Job Description

This is an individual contributor role on the Performance Marketing team. You will own the day-to-day execution of paid campaigns across channels, manage budgets, and drive customer acquisition for instashop.

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing at instashop on Marcomms strategy, incentive tracking, and business performance analysis, but also work as a dotted line with Talabat’s performance marketing lead. This is a hybrid role: part campaign executor, part strategic analyst. You need to be comfortable switching between both.

The team expects you to run lean. That means embedding AI into your workflow, cutting manual steps wherever possible, and operating at a pace that matches the business.

Campaign Execution

Own end-to-end campaign setup, bidding, and optimisation across Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels.
Take creatives live, test new formats, and iterate based on performance data.
Manage daily budget allocation and pacing to hit CAC targets.
Monitor campaign health and flag issues before they compound.

Performance Analysis

Analyse campaign performance across the full funnel, from impression to conversion.
Build and maintain regular performance reports for the Head of Marketing and senior stakeholders across the two main markets (UAE & Egypt)
Track incentive performance and contribute to business performance reviews.
Identify CAC efficiency opportunities and bring data-backed recommendations.

Experimentation

Design and run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, bids, and landing experiences.
Document test hypotheses, results, and learnings in a structured way.
Propose new experiments based on platform signals, competitive benchmarks, and your own analysis.

Strategy and Marcomms Collaboration

Work closely with the Head of Marketing at instashop on marketing communications planning and calendar.
Support incentive design and tracking, aligning promotional activity with acquisition goals.
Contribute to quarterly planning with performance data and channel insights.

Qualifications

Platform Depth

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager: campaign structures, bidding strategies, Advantage+ campaigns, and creative best practices.
Working knowledge of TikTok Ads: smart campaigns, TopView, In-Feed, and short-form content performance patterns.
Familiarity with how short-form content (Reels, TikToks) behaves differently in paid vs organic and how to use that to brief or iterate on creative.
Working knowledge of other platforms such as Google, Apple Ads, Snapchat etc.
Understanding of attribution and MMP mechanics: how platforms like Adjust or AppsFlyer measure installs, events, and in-app revenue, and where discrepancies come from.

AI-First Way of Working

You are expected to use AI tools actively in your day-to-day: for reporting, analysis, brief writing, and workflow automation.
The goal is to reduce manual overhead, not just stay busy. If you are doing something repetitive that a well-prompted tool can do, you should already be automating it.
Comfort with prompt engineering and integrating AI outputs into real workflows is a strong plus.

Analytical Rigour

You can pull data, build a view, and explain what it means without being hand-held.
You understand incrementality vs. last-touch attribution, and you can have an informed conversation about channel contribution.
You know what CAC, LTV, ROAS, and CPM mean in practice, not just as definitions.

Speed and Ownership

You do not wait to be told what is wrong. You monitor, spot it, and fix it or flag it.
You manage your own workload across campaigns and strategic tasks without dropping either.
Fast-paced environment is not a cliche here. It is the actual pace of this team.

Qualifications

3 to 5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with at least 2 years focused on paid social.
Experience managing and allocating performance marketing budgets across channels and markets with the ability to optimize spend based business objectives.
Proven track record running Meta and TikTok campaigns, not just setting them up.
Experience working with MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer, or equivalent) and understanding attribution at a platform level.
Exposure to q-commerce, food delivery, or e-commerce is a strong plus.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

Nice to Have

Experience running campaigns across both brand and performance objectives simultaneously.
Experience briefing creative teams and giving structured feedback on short-form video assets.
Hands-on use of AI tools in a marketing context (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar).

Workflow Automation: Design, develop, and maintain semi-automated production workflows for in-house video and stills creation — including virtual production pipelines and GenAI-assisted processes

A typical day includes coding and developing tools, workflows, and automation to improve the creative crew's experience and increase productivity. Senior / Lead Creative Strategist

Simmer | London | Full-time

Simmer is one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer brands, built on a simple idea: healthy food should taste extraordinary. Founded by brothers Simmy and Jhai with £10 of ingredients, we've grown into a profitable, bootstrapped business generating over £100m in annual recurring revenue, ranking #5 in The Sunday Times 100.

But we still think we're early.

Our ambition is to become the defining brand in healthy eating.

We're fully founder-led, without private equity or corporate layers. The founders remain deeply involved in the business, decisions happen quickly and the people who join us have the opportunity to materially shape what Simmer becomes.

We've built our growth through product quality, performance marketing and founder-led storytelling. Creative has been one of our biggest competitive advantages, helping us reach tens of thousands of customers across the UK.

Now we want to take that advantage much further.

The opportunity

We're looking for an exceptional Senior / Lead Creative Strategist
who understands the relationship between creative, consumer behaviour and commercial performance.

Someone who can look at our acquisition engine, understand what is driving growth today and identify what could make it significantly better tomorrow.

You'll have access to meaningful paid media investment, high volumes of creative testing, rich performance data and a talented team of producers and editors who can bring ideas to life.

You'll work directly with our founder and closely with the people responsible for growth, helping determine which audiences we target, what messages resonate and where we invest our creative efforts.

This isn't a role for someone who simply writes briefs or comes up with interesting ideas.

We want someone who can answer the harder questions:
Why are certain ads outperforming everything else?
Which audiences and customer motivations are we not reaching?
Where are we seeing creative fatigue or diminishing returns, and what should we do about it?
Which new concepts, formats and messages could materially improve acquisition?
How do we turn individual creative wins into a repeatable engine for growth?
Where should we focus our time, creative resources and media investment to generate the greatest return?

You might be a senior Creative Strategist with exceptional performance marketing knowledge, or an experienced Performance Marketer with outstanding creative instincts.

We're open-minded about your background and title. What matters is your ability to combine commercial insight, creative thinking and execution to deliver measurable growth.
For the right person, the role could extend into broader performance marketing ownership.

What you'll do

Own the creative growth opportunity

Understand our acquisition performance, identify the biggest opportunities and develop a clear creative strategy to capture them. Think beyond individual campaigns to customer segments, positioning, messaging and sustainable growth.

Turn performance data into better creative

Go deep into Meta performance, CAC, conversion, creative fatigue, testing results and customer behaviour. Understand why something works, not simply whether it works, and translate those insights into clear creative decisions.

Develop concepts that move the numbers

Create and shape compelling concepts, hooks, scripts and briefs grounded in consumer psychology and commercial insight. Work closely with our production team, editors and creators to turn ideas into high-performing content.

Build a stronger experimentation engine

Identify what we should test, how we should test it and what we'll learn. Develop new angles, challenge assumptions, iterate quickly and scale ideas that demonstrate genuine incremental value.

Connect creative and media performance

Work across creative and performance to understand how messaging, audiences, spend and acquisition economics interact. Help shape decisions around what to produce, what to scale and where to focus investment.

Raise the standard

Develop a strong point of view on what great performance creative looks like. Challenge mediocre ideas, improve the quality of thinking and help the team become more commercially effective without slowing down execution.

Take ownership of outcomes

We're not looking for someone who measures success by how many briefs they've written or campaigns they've launched. We care about what improves as a result of their work.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in how impressive your job title sounds or how many people you've managed than the quality of your thinking, the decisions you've made and the results you've delivered.

You'll bring:
Proven performance impact.
You've helped improve customer acquisition through creative strategy, paid social or a combination of both, and can explain what you personally contributed.
Strong Meta and acquisition knowledge.
You understand the mechanics of paid social, creative testing, CAC, conversion and scaling performance.
Exceptional creative judgement.
You instinctively understand hooks, storytelling, consumer psychology, messaging and what makes people pay attention and take action.
Analytical depth.
You're comfortable working with performance data, spotting patterns, forming hypotheses and making decisions that improve commercial outcomes.
Experience at pace.
You've worked in an environment where creative is tested frequently, feedback is immediate and strong ideas are developed and iterated quickly.
Ownership and ambition.
You're comfortable taking responsibility, challenging assumptions and finding solutions without waiting to be told what to do.
Intellectual curiosity and humility.
You're constantly learning, testing your thinking and willing to change your mind when the evidence says you should.

Why Simmer?

A meaningful growth challenge

We've already built a £100m+ ARR business. The next stage isn't about proving the model works. It's about finding the opportunities that take us much further.

Real scale, without corporate complexity

You'll have meaningful media investment, performance data and creative resources, but still be close enough to the decisions to make things happen quickly.

Work directly with the founder

You'll work closely with Simmy, shaping the creative and commercial decisions that influence how the business grows.

Influence the work, not just the output

We want someone who challenges our thinking, identifies opportunities we've missed and raises the quality of decisions across creative and performance.

A role that can grow with you

We're open-minded about where this role develops. For someone with the right capabilities, there's significant scope to take on broader ownership across creative strategy, performance marketing and growth.

Who will thrive here?

Someone who's commercially sharp, creatively ambitious and intellectually curious.
Someone who can go from analysing acquisition performance to developing an exceptional creative concept, then work with a team to bring it to life.
Someone who has strong opinions but isn't attached to being right.
Someone who values pace, takes ownership and cares as much about commercial results as the quality of the ideas.
Most importantly, someone who's excited by the opportunity to make a measurable difference to one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer businesses.

If you love understanding why creative works, identifying growth opportunities others miss and turning those insights into commercial results, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and, ideally, examples of performance creative or acquisition initiatives you've led, the thinking behind them and the results they delivered.

As we continue to grow, our team keeps expanding across the UAE, Egypt and Greece, and we’re always on the lookout for new talents to join us on our success journey.

Job Description

This is an individual contributor role on the Performance Marketing team. You will own the day-to-day execution of paid campaigns across channels, manage budgets, and drive customer acquisition for instashop.

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing at instashop on Marcomms strategy, incentive tracking, and business performance analysis, but also work as a dotted line with Talabat’s performance marketing lead. This is a hybrid role: part campaign executor, part strategic analyst. You need to be comfortable switching between both.

The team expects you to run lean. That means embedding AI into your workflow, cutting manual steps wherever possible, and operating at a pace that matches the business.

Campaign Execution

Own end-to-end campaign setup, bidding, and optimisation across Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels.
Take creatives live, test new formats, and iterate based on performance data.
Manage daily budget allocation and pacing to hit CAC targets.
Monitor campaign health and flag issues before they compound.

Performance Analysis

Analyse campaign performance across the full funnel, from impression to conversion.
Build and maintain regular performance reports for the Head of Marketing and senior stakeholders across the two main markets (UAE & Egypt)
Track incentive performance and contribute to business performance reviews.
Identify CAC efficiency opportunities and bring data-backed recommendations.

Experimentation

Design and run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, bids, and landing experiences.
Document test hypotheses, results, and learnings in a structured way.
Propose new experiments based on platform signals, competitive benchmarks, and your own analysis.

Strategy and Marcomms Collaboration

Work closely with the Head of Marketing at instashop on marketing communications planning and calendar.
Support incentive design and tracking, aligning promotional activity with acquisition goals.
Contribute to quarterly planning with performance data and channel insights.

Qualifications

Platform Depth

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager: campaign structures, bidding strategies, Advantage+ campaigns, and creative best practices.
Working knowledge of TikTok Ads: smart campaigns, TopView, In-Feed, and short-form content performance patterns.
Familiarity with how short-form content (Reels, TikToks) behaves differently in paid vs organic and how to use that to brief or iterate on creative.
Working knowledge of other platforms such as Google, Apple Ads, Snapchat etc.
Understanding of attribution and MMP mechanics: how platforms like Adjust or AppsFlyer measure installs, events, and in-app revenue, and where discrepancies come from.

AI-First Way of Working

You are expected to use AI tools actively in your day-to-day: for reporting, analysis, brief writing, and workflow automation.

You know what CAC, LTV, ROAS, and CPM mean in practice, not just as definitions.

Speed and Ownership

You do not wait to be told what is wrong. You monitor, spot it, and fix it or flag it.
You manage your own workload across campaigns and strategic tasks without dropping either.
Fast-paced environment is not a cliche here. It is the actual pace of this team.

Experience managing and allocating performance marketing budgets across channels and markets with the ability to optimize spend based business objectives.
Proven track record running Meta and TikTok campaigns, not just setting them up.
